theme: A wide-open Saturday before tomorrow's handoff.
greeting: Nothing is on the calendar today, Dan — a genuinely clear Saturday, and the girls are still with you and Mike before tomorrow's handoff to Jen. The only thing on the horizon is the 9 AM Sunday review, so the day is yours to spend on the kids or on the travel decisions that have slipped.

needsAttention.title: Sunday review with Mike
needsAttention.detail: The weekly 15-minute board sweep is first thing tomorrow. Several big items have slipped three weeks running, so it is the natural place to finally land the December trip and the Christmas car.

needsAttention.title: December trip still undecided
needsAttention.detail: The decision was due Sept 30 and the book-by is Oct 15. Holiday inventory for six people across three weeks is the thinnest of the year, so the date really does bind.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV not booked
needsAttention.detail: A p1 open since Sept 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market, and a refundable hold held now costs nothing.

needsAttention.title: LinkedIn note from Pru
needsAttention.detail: A message from Pru has been sitting in LinkedIn since Wednesday without a reply.

flagged.title: Public-affairs director roles
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced Cohere and FUJIFILM government-affairs openings, squarely in your lane.

flagged.title: NACD New England, Oct 28
flagged.detail: NACD asked members to share its Maine Visionaries event — a governance-network touchpoint.

flagged.title: AppleCare One action needed
flagged.detail: Apple flagged a new account signing into your iPhone 17e and asks you to sign in to keep coverage.

flagged.detail: Morgan Stanley and Revolut both posted monthly statements overnight.

inbox.noise: Beneath that, the usual newsletters — FT, WSJ, Press Herald, the St. Pete and Midcoast locals — plus a run of receipts and shipping notices.

recipe.why: Autumn is chanterelle season — a good week to let wild mushrooms carry a simple roast.

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar — a rare, fully open morning with the girls still home.
The clear stretch runs straight through; no meetings and no calls booked.
One last evening with the four of them before tomorrow's review and the handoff.
